svg.text: Does a theorised lever give the same answer on 5 independent draws of its 27 cells?
Same designs, same prompts, new seeds for every subject and measurement call. Draw 1 is the original run.

Verdict: Qwen levers, ✓ if Qwen's own predicted direction holds; GPT-Sol levers, sign of the high-minus-low contrast on the primary outcome.
|t| = |OLS coefficient| / HC1 robust SE from outcome ~ 1 + level indices, fitted separately in each draw.
